links.comparator_used: Unaided radiologists reading without AI (trauma surgeons using AI-visual guidance compared against them); the AI-alert session was a separate arm and no direct visual-vs-alert result is reported in the text
links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy on pelvic radiographs (trauma surgeons with AI-visual guidance vs unaided radiologists)
links.effect: Accuracy 0.940 vs 0.920, p = 0.556. Pooled across all AI support, overall accuracy rose from 0.870 to 0.940 (p < 0.001) and reading time fell from 22.70 to 9.58 s (p < 0.001).
links.quote: Trauma surgeons with AI-visual guidance achieved comparable accuracy to unaided radiologists (0.940 vs. 0.920, p = 0.556).

design_hint: AI output presentation format (alert vs visual guidance) for clinician readers
